coverImageAlt: Three navy storyboard frames transform a miniature stone sphere scene into a luminous cyan cinematic flow.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: Cinematic prompt construction represented by a hand-built sequence of three physical storyboard windows transforming a small scene model into a flowing strip of light, conveying how a cinematographer specifies subject, camera movement, atmosphere, and shot progression for generative video.
Scene/backdrop: A warm-paper miniature film stage set on a slate workbench, entirely abstract and unbranded.
Subject: Three freestanding navy frames containing only tactile abstract scene elements—a stone sphere, a curved cyan track, and shifting light—with one continuous cyan cinematic ribbon weaving through them and a sparing orange focus marker.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; one strong crop-safe sequence from miniature scene through three frames; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: cinematic, deliberate, imaginative; controlled pools of directional light
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: frames contain no screens, controls, captions, marks, or interface elements; no cameras or film-company branding; completely original image; no input or reference images; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermark, product UI, vendor branding, Microsoft Fluent styling, paw imagery, paw logo, cats, or cat silhouettes
